title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
title_zh: SimForcing：将模拟运动先验提炼为真实域机器人世界模型

paragraphs.en: Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy. Our simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance scheme unifies these two ideas by balancing predictions based on internalized motion knowledge with those additionally guided by simulation latents. The jointly trained student generates both simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference. On Bridge, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD among the compared methods without external embodied pretraining. Evaluation on InternData-A1 further supports its applicability across robot datasets. Moreover, using our trained world model to initialize a vision-language-action model improves LIBERO success, suggesting its utility for downstream policy learning. paragraphs.en: Recent advances in large-scale video generation and world foundation models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Chi et al., 2025 ; Ali et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026a ) , have expanded the potential of learned visual dynamics for embodied intelligence. Beyond video synthesis, these models can generate training experiences for robot policies ( Jang et al., 2025 ) and support the improvement of vision-language-action (VLA) models through synthetic rollouts ( Guo et al., 2026b ) . Benchmarks such as WorldArena ( Shang et al., 2026 ) further assess their utility as data engines, policy evaluators, and action planners. Despite this progress, visually convincing predictions do not necessarily ensure reliable physical interactions or strong downstream performance ( Shang et al., 2026 ) . For robotic manipulation, a key challenge remains: learning precise responses to continuous action trajectories while preserving realistic appearance and temporally coherent scene dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模视频生成和世界基础模型（Wan 等，2025；Chi 等，2025；Ali 等，2025；Ma 等，2026a）的最新进展，拓展了基于学习的视觉动态在具身智能中的潜力。 除了视频合成之外，这些模型还能生成机器人策略的训练体验（Jang 等，2025），并通过合成式展开支持视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的改进（Guo 等，2026b）。 诸如 WorldArena（Shang 等，2026）之类的基准测试进一步评估了它们作为数据引擎、策略评估器和动作规划器的效用。 尽管取得了这些进展，但视觉上令人信服的预测并不必然意味着可靠的物理交互或强大的下游性能（Shang 等，2026）。 对于机器人操作而言，一个关键挑战依然存在：在保持真实外观和时间上连贯的场景动态的同时，学习对连续动作轨迹的精确响应。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches address this problem through different training paradigms, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . One approach learns video prediction directly from real robot videos and their associated actions such as IRASim ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) and Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026c ) . This provides direct supervision for action-conditioned generation, but learning precise action responses and complex visual dynamics jointly from real videos remains challenging. Another approach introduces an explicit visual structure. For example, RoboDream ( Ye et al., 2026a ) anchors generation to rendered robot motion and conditions on scene and object priors. Such compositional inputs provide additional control, while requiring the corresponding priors to be constructed and supplied. Qwen-RobotWorld ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) also needs scene video as prior. However, the potential of simulation data to improve real-video prediction without additional priors remains underexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过不同的训练范式来解决这个问题，如图 1 所示。 一种方法直接从真实机器人视频及其相关动作中学习视频预测，例如 IRASim（Zhu 等人，2025b）和 Ctrl-World（Guo 等人，2026c）。 这为基于动作的生成提供了直接监督，但从真实视频中联合学习精确的动作响应和复杂的视觉动态仍然具有挑战性。 另一种方法引入了显式的视觉结构。 例如，RoboDream（Ye 等人，2026a）将生成锚定在渲染出的机器人运动上，并以场景和对象先验作为条件。 这类组合输入提供了额外的控制，但同时也需要预先构建并提供相应的先验知识。 Qwen-RobotWorld（Zhang 等人，2026a）也需要场景视频作为先验。 然而，模拟数据在不依赖额外先验的情况下提升真实视频预测能力的潜力尚未得到充分探索。

paragraphs.en: Simulation provides structured supervision for action-dependent motion, complementing the appearance and interaction diversity of real videos. Transferring this knowledge nevertheless presents two challenges. First, appearance differences complicate direct matching between simulated and real observations. Second, predicted simulation trajectories are imperfect; a real-domain model that relies too heavily on them may inherit their errors. These challenges motivate transferring motion knowledge through temporal differences in latent space to mitigate the influence of appearance differences, while controlling the model’s reliance on potentially inaccurate simulation predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟为依赖动作的运动提供了结构化的监督，从而补充了真实视频中外观和交互的多样性。 然而，迁移这种知识仍然存在两个挑战。 首先，外观差异使得模拟观察与真实观察之间的直接匹配变得复杂。 其次，预测的模拟轨迹并不完美；如果真实域模型过度依赖这些轨迹，就可能会继承其中的错误。 这些挑战促使我们通过潜在空间中时间差异来迁移运动知识，以减轻外观差异的影响，同时控制模型对可能不准确的模拟预测的依赖程度。

paragraphs.en: We present SimForcing , a novel world modeling framework that addresses these challenges through motion knowledge transfer and controllable simulation guidance. To transfer motion knowledge across domains with different appearances, we first train a mixture-of-transformers world model on synthetic rollouts with trajectory augmentation, learning action-dependent motion from diverse robot trajectories. The resulting model initializes the student and serves as a frozen teacher. Our key transfer mechanism is latent-motion distillation, which aligns temporal differences between adjacent teacher and student video latents rather than directly matching their appearances. This motion-focused supervision internalizes the teacher’s simulation-derived priors within the student, directly enhancing its ability to predict real-world video dynamics. Joint flow-matching and motion-distillation objectives on paired simulated and real videos further develop prediction capabilities in both domains within the same student, without requiring additional scene or object decomposition.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SimForcing，一种新颖的世界建模框架，它通过运动知识迁移和可控的模拟引导来解决这些挑战。 为了在不同外观的领域之间迁移运动知识，我们首先在包含轨迹增强的合成模拟数据上训练一个混合变换器世界模型，从而从多样化的机器人轨迹中学习依赖于动作的运动模式。 由此得到的模型为学生模型提供初始化，并作为冻结的教师模型使用。 我们的核心迁移机制是潜在运动蒸馏，它通过对齐相邻的教师和学生视频潜在表示之间的时序差异，而非直接匹配其外观来实现迁移。 这种以运动为核心的监督方式将教师模型基于模拟获得的先验知识内化到学生模型中，直接增强了其预测真实世界视频动态的能力。 在成对的模拟和真实视频上联合执行流匹配和运动蒸馏目标，能够进一步在同一学生模型中提升两个领域的预测能力，而无需对场景或物体进行额外分解。

paragraphs.en: To benefit from explicit simulation predictions without becoming overly dependent on their accuracy, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout. This design enables the model to exploit reliable simulation predictions while limiting the influence of inaccurate ones. The jointly trained student generates both the simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference.

paragraphs.en: Large-scale video generators provide increasingly capable visual priors for world modeling ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2025 ; Ali et al., 2025 ; Chi et al., 2025 ) , with recent efforts extending pretraining and adaptation toward embodied interaction. Qwen-RobotWorld ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) uses natural-language actions to predict future visual trajectories across manipulation, navigation, and driving, while LingBot-Video ( Ma et al., 2026a ) scales mixture-of-experts video pretraining with robot-oriented data. DreamGen ( Jang et al., 2025 ) adapts video generators to target robot embodiments and recovers action labels through inverse dynamics or latent action models, producing synthetic trajectories for policy learning. RoboScape ( Shang et al., 2025 ) incorporates physical priors through joint RGB–depth prediction and keypoint-based temporal consistency. PhysisForcing ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) improves physical consistency using supervision constructed through a multi-model pipeline involving point tracking, depth-aware region selection, and semantic relation extraction. In contrast, our latent-motion distillation derives supervision directly from temporal differences in a simulation-pretrained teacher’s predicted video latents, without constructing explicit depth, point-trajectory, or semantic-relation targets.
paragraphs.zh: 大规模视频生成器为世界建模提供了能力日益强大的视觉先验（Wan 等，2025；Agarwal 等，2025；Ali 等，2025；Chi 等，2025），近期的研究已将预训练和自适应扩展至具身交互领域。 Qwen-RobotWorld（Zhang 等，2026a）利用自然语言动作预测操作、导航和驾驶过程中未来的视觉轨迹，而 LingBot-Video（Ma 等，2026a）则通过面向机器人的数据扩大了专家混合视频预训练的规模。 DreamGen（Jang 等，2025）将视频生成器适配到特定的机器人具身形态，并通过逆动力学或潜在动作模型恢复动作标签，从而为策略学习生成合成轨迹。 RoboScape（Shang 等，2025）通过联合 RGB-深度预测和基于关键点的时序一致性，融入了物理先验知识。 PhysisForcing（Zhang 等，2026b）利用由多模型流程构建的监督信号来增强物理一致性，该流程包括点跟踪、深度感知区域选择和语义关系提取。 相比之下，我们的潜在运动蒸馏方法直接从预训练于模拟环境中的教师模型所预测的视频潜在表示的时间差异中提取监督信号，而无需构建显式的深度、点轨迹或语义关系目标。

paragraphs.en: Action-conditioned world models connect robot controls to predicted visual outcomes. IRASim ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) learns from historical observations and continuous actions, while AVID ( Rigter et al., 2024 ) adds an action-conditioned adapter to a frozen video diffusion model. Dynamic World Simulation ( He et al., 2026 ) combines action conditioning with a motion-reinforced objective. EnerVerse-AC ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) uses multi-level action conditioning for multiview generation, and Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026c ) supports policy-in-the-loop simulation with frame-level control and temporal memory. Other methods encode control as spatial visual signals: RoboMaster ( Fu et al., 2026 ) uses collaborative robot–object trajectories, ABot-PhysWorld ( Chen et al., 2026c ) combines spatial action injection with physics-aligned training, and OSCAR ( Wu and Gao, 2026 ) uses rendered kinematic skeletons across embodiments. EA-WM ( Yang et al., 2026 ) projects actions and kinematic states into camera-aligned visual action fields, with event-aware bidirectional fusion supervised by VAE-encoded frame differences. Masked Visual Actions ( Alzayer et al., 2026 ) reveals robot or object motion in masked videos, unifying forward and inverse world modeling through a shared pixel-space control interface. FlowWAM ( Chen et al., 2026b ) adopts optical flow for video prediction and policy learning, while RynnWorld-Teleop ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) uses hand-pose conditioning for real-time teleoperation.
paragraphs.zh: 以动作条件化的世界模型将机器人控制与预测的视觉结果连接起来。 IRASim（Zhu 等，2025b）从历史观测和连续动作中学习，而 AVID（Rigter 等，2024）则在一个冻结的视频扩散模型中加入了以动作条件化的适配器。 动态世界模拟（He 等，2026）将动作条件化与运动增强目标相结合。 EnerVerse-AC（Jiang 等，2025）使用多级动作条件化进行多视角生成，而 Ctrl-World（Guo 等，2026c）支持在策略循环中进行模拟，并具备帧级控制和时序记忆功能。 其他方法将控制编码为空间视觉信号：RoboMaster（Fu 等，2026）使用协作机器人与物体的轨迹，ABot-PhysWorld（Chen 等，2026c）结合空间动作注入与物理对齐训练，而 OSCAR（Wu 和 Gao，2026）则在不同具身形态中使用渲染出的运动学骨架。 EA-WM（Yang 等，2026）将动作和运动学状态投影到与相机对齐的视觉动作场中，并通过事件感知双向融合，由 VAE 编码的帧差异进行监督。 掩码视觉动作（Alzayer 等，2026）在掩码视频中揭示机器人或物体的运动，通过共享的像素空间控制接口统一了正向和反向世界建模。 FlowWAM（Chen 等，2026b）采用光流进行视频预测和策略学习，而 RynnWorld-Teleop（Zhao 等，2026b）则使用手部姿态条件化实现实时远程操作。

paragraphs.en: Recent efforts further incorporate 3D and 4D structure into embodied prediction and control. TesserAct ( Zhen et al., 2025 ) jointly generates RGB, depth, and normal sequences for 4D scene reconstruction. Robo4DGen ( Liu et al., 2026b ) introduces cross-view pointmap supervision for geometrically consistent multiview prediction, while MVISTA-4D ( Wang et al., 2026a ) generates arbitrary-view RGB-D futures through cross-view and cross-modality feature fusion. RoboStereo ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) couples action-conditioned RGB and pointmap generation through a dual-tower diffusion architecture, and RynnWorld-4D ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) jointly predicts RGB, depth, and optical flow to model appearance, geometry, and motion. Kinema4D ( Xu et al., 2026a ) uses URDF-based kinematics to construct robot pointmap trajectories as control signals for synchronized RGB and pointmap generation. CausalWM ( Xu et al., 2026b ) sequentially predicts optical flow, 3D pointmaps, and RGB videos, using intermediate predictions as context for subsequent generation. PointWorld ( Huang et al., 2026 ) instead models scene dynamics directly as 3D point flows, representing robot actions in the same space and learning across embodiments from real and simulated manipulation data. X-WAM ( Guo et al., 2026a ) further couples multiview RGB-D prediction with robot action generation, using a lightweight depth branch and asynchronous denoising to decode actions with fewer steps than video. WAM4D ( Li et al., 2026d ) uses spatial register tokens and future-depth supervision to transfer geometric priors into video–action representations, removing the geometric readout branch for efficient action inference. Our work addresses the complementary problem of transferring simulation-derived motion knowledge into real-domain video prediction, combining latent-motion distillation with simulation guidance generated by the same model.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究进一步将三维和四维结构整合到具身预测与控制中。 TesserAct（Zhen 等，2025）联合生成 RGB、深度和法线序列，以实现四维场景重建。 Robo4DGen（Liu 等，2026b）引入了跨视角点云图监督，以实现几何一致的多视角预测；而 MVISTA-4D（Wang 等，2026a）则通过跨视角和跨模态特征融合生成任意视角的 RGB-D 未来状态。 RoboStereo（Zhang 等，2026c）通过双塔扩散架构将动作条件化的 RGB 和点云图生成耦合在一起；RynnWorld-4D（Zhao 等，2026a）则联合预测 RGB、深度和光流，以建模外观、几何和运动。 Kinema4D（Xu 等，2026a）利用基于 URDF 的运动学构建机器人点云图轨迹，作为同步生成 RGB 和点云图的控制信号。 CausalWM（Xu 等，2026b）依次预测光流、三维点云图和 RGB 视频，并将中间预测结果作为后续生成的上下文。 PointWorld（Huang 等，2026）则直接将场景动态建模为三维点流，在相同空间中表示机器人动作，并通过真实和模拟操作数据跨具身学习。 X-WAM（Guo 等，2026a）进一步将多视角 RGB-D 预测与机器人动作生成耦合在一起，利用轻量级深度分支和异步降噪技术，以比视频更少的步骤解码动作。 WAM4D（Li 等，2026d）使用空间注册标记和未来深度监督，将几何先验转移到视频-动作表示中，从而移除几何读取分支，实现高效的动作推理。 我们的工作解决了将模拟衍生出的运动知识迁移到真实域视频预测这一互补问题，结合潜在运动蒸馏与由同一模型生成的模拟引导。

paragraphs.en: Recent work also revisits the visual supervision and generative backbones used for control. MaskWAM ( Yu et al., 2026 ) jointly predicts future RGB observations, task-relevant masks, and actions, using optional initial mask prompts to ground target selection. ImageWAM ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) instead replaces dense future-video modeling with a source-to-target-frame editing objective and conditions an action expert on intermediate editing features, without decoding the target image at inference. Complementing these policy-oriented designs, our method focuses on action-conditioned real-domain video prediction. It distills simulation-derived motion through temporal latent differences and uses the same model to generate simulation guidance from input actions and a segmented robot observation, without external robot-motion rendering at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究也重新审视了控制任务中使用的视觉监督机制和生成式主干网络。 MaskWAM（Yu 等人，2026）通过可选的初始掩码提示来锚定目标选择，并联合预测未来的 RGB 观测结果、任务相关的掩码以及动作。 相比之下，ImageWAM（Zhang 等人，2026d）将密集的未来视频建模替换为从源帧到目标帧的编辑目标，并将动作专家的条件建立在中间编辑特征之上，而无需在推理阶段解码目标图像。 作为对这些策略导向设计的补充，我们的方法专注于以动作为条件的真实域视频预测。 该方法通过时间上的潜在差异来提炼模拟中获得的运动信息，并使用同一模型根据输入动作和分割后的机器人观测结果生成模拟指导，而无需在推理阶段进行外部的机器人运动渲染。

paragraphs.en: Simulation supports robot learning through data augmentation, dynamics transfer, and visual conditioning. Sim-and-Real Co-Training ( Maddukuri et al., 2025 ) mixes synthetic and real demonstrations for policy learning, while RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) scales synthetic data generation with structured domain randomization. ReDRAW ( Lanier et al., 2025 ) adapts simulation-pretrained latent dynamics through residual corrections, and Simulation Distillation ( Levy et al., 2026 ) transfers simulator priors into world models for real-world adaptation and planning. For video generation, Cosmos-Transfer1 ( Alhaija et al., 2025 ) supports sim-to-real visual translation through spatial controls. GeniWorld ( Gu et al., 2026 ) and AnchorDream ( Ye et al., 2025 ) condition video generation on rendered robot motion, while RoboDream ( Ye et al., 2026a ) additionally incorporates explicit scene and object priors. These methods rely on external robot-motion rendering to construct conditioning inputs at inference. In contrast, our method uses the same model for both simulation-domain and real-scene prediction, without invoking an external simulator at inference. Conditioned on the input actions and a robot-only image obtained by semantically segmenting the initial observation, the model predicts simulation-domain video latents that then guide its real-scene video prediction. This model-generated guidance complements the motion knowledge internalized through latent-motion distillation. Our simulation-conditioning CFG scheme controls its influence to limit reliance on inaccurate predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟通过数据增强、动力学迁移和视觉条件化支持机器人学习。 Sim-and-Real Co-Training（Maddukuri 等人，2025）将合成演示与真实演示结合用于策略学习，而 RoboTwin 2.0（Chen 等人，2025）则通过结构化领域随机化扩展了合成数据的生成能力。 ReDRAW（Lanier 等人，2025）通过残差校正调整了模拟预训练的潜在动力学模型，而 Simulation Distillation（Levy 等人，2026）则将模拟器的先验知识迁移到世界模型中，以实现真实世界的适应与规划。 在视频生成方面，Cosmos-Transfer1（Alhaija 等人，2025）通过空间控制支持了从模拟到真实的视觉转换。 GeniWorld（Gu 等人，2026）和 AnchorDream（Ye 等人，2025）将视频生成条件化于渲染后的机器人运动，而 RoboDream（Ye 等人，2026a）还进一步融入了显式的场景与物体先验知识。 这些方法在推理阶段依赖外部的机器人运动渲染来构建条件输入。 相比之下，我们的方法在模拟域和真实场景预测中均使用同一模型，无需在推理阶段调用外部模拟器。 在输入动作以及通过语义分割初始观察图像获得的仅包含机器人的图像条件下，该模型会预测模拟域的视频潜在表示，进而指导其对真实场景视频的预测。 这种由模型生成的引导信息，补充了通过潜在运动蒸馏内化的运动知识。 我们的模拟条件化 CFG 方案控制了其影响程度，以限制对不准确预测的依赖。

paragraphs.en: The core idea of this part is to transfer motion priors from simulation to the real domain through latent-space distillation. During simulation pretraining, the world model learns to predict future robot motion from the initial observation and action sequence. By excluding object interactions and background complexity, this training focuses on the robot’s action-conditioned motion dynamics. The learned latent representations then provide motion supervision and conditioning signals for training the real-domain world model.

paragraphs.en: We conduct our main evaluation and ablations on Bridge ( Walke et al., 2023 ) , assess generalization on InternData-A1 ( Tian et al., 2026 ) , and evaluate downstream VLA learning on LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) . For video prediction, models generate future frames from an initial observation and an action trajectory. The baseline combines Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) with a 1B Action DiT and is trained on real videos. We compare with Cosmos-Predict2.5 ( Ali et al., 2025 ) , GeniWorld ( Gu et al., 2026 ) , IRASim ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) , Ctrl-World ( Guo et al., 2026c ) , and EnerVerse-AC ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . SimForcing learns motion priors from synthetic rollouts and trains a student on paired simulated and real videos under a frozen simulation teacher. We report PSNR and SSIM for reconstruction fidelity, LPIPS for perceptual similarity, and FID and FVD for image- and video-level distributional quality. Higher PSNR and SSIM and lower LPIPS, FID, and FVD are better. For downstream policy learning, we report task success rates on LIBERO. More details can be found in the Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Bridge (Walke et al., 2023) 上进行主要评估和消融研究，在 InternData-A1 (Tian et al., 2026) 上评估泛化能力，并在 LIBERO (Liu et al., 2023) 上评估下游 VLA 学习性能。 对于视频预测，模型会根据初始观察结果和行动轨迹生成未来帧。 基线模型将 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B (Wan et al., 2025) 与一个 1B Action DiT 相结合，并在真实视频上进行训练。 我们与 Cosmos-Predict2.5 (Ali et al., 2025)、GeniWorld (Gu et al., 2026)、IRASim (Zhu et al., 2025b)、Ctrl-World (Guo et al., 2026c) 和 EnerVerse-AC (Jiang et al., 2025) 进行了比较。 SimForcing 从合成展开中学习运动先验，并在冻结的模拟教师模型下，使用成对的模拟视频和真实视频训练学生模型。 我们报告了用于重建保真度的 PSNR 和 SSIM、用于感知相似性的 LPIPS，以及用于图像和视频级别分布质量的 FID 和 FVD。 PSNR 和 SSIM 越高、LPIPS、FID 和 FVD 越低越好。 对于下游策略学习，我们报告了 LIBERO 上的任务成功率。 更多细节请参见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 1 compares action-conditioned video prediction on Bridge. Among models without embodied pretraining, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD. Compared with GeniWorld, it provides closer agreement with action-conditioned reference videos at the same reported inference time, with a slightly higher FID reflecting a trade-off between prediction fidelity and image-level distributional quality. Both methods perform segmentation at inference, requiring only 0.3 s per sample. Cosmos-Predict2.5 achieves higher PSNR and SSIM and lower FVD, while SimForcing attains lower LPIPS with approximately five times faster inference. These results support the benefits of simulation-derived priors for prediction while maintaining practical inference costs. The qualitative comparisons in Fig. 3 (left) further illustrate these benefits on both Bridge and InternData-A1. In the shown examples, compared to other methods, SimForcing produces fewer visual hallucinations and motion that more closely follows the specified actions.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 比较了 Bridge 数据集上基于动作的视频预测效果。 在没有具身预训练的模型中，SimForcing 在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 和 FVD 指标上表现最佳。 与 GeniWorld 相比，在报告相同的推理时间下，SimForcing 与基于动作的参考视频更为一致，但 FID 略高，反映出预测保真度与图像级分布质量之间的权衡。 两种方法都在推理阶段执行分割，每样本仅需 0.3 秒。 Cosmos-Predict2.5 实现了更高的 PSNR 和 SSIM 以及更低的 FVD，而 SimForcing 的 LPIPS 更低，且推理速度约快五倍。 这些结果支持了模拟衍生先验在保持实用推理成本的同时对预测的有益作用。 图 3（左）中的定性比较进一步展示了这些方法在 Bridge 和 InternData-A1 数据集上的优势。 在所示示例中，与其他方法相比，SimForcing 产生的视觉幻觉更少，且运动更贴近指定的动作。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 2 shows that joint flow matching and trajectory augmentation improve all five metrics over real-video SFT. With augmentation, motion distillation achieves the lowest FID and FVD, while combining it with simulation conditioning yields the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS. This reflects a trade-off: the full model prioritizes prediction fidelity and perceptual similarity to reference videos over distributional quality. Tab. 3 further shows that latent-motion distillation outperforms latent-value matching on four metrics, supporting temporal differences as a transfer target that mitigates the influence of cross-domain appearance differences. CFG provides additional control over this trade-off: w = 0.6 w=0.6 achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, whereas w = 1 w=1 yields the lowest FID and FVD. Fig. 3 (right) further illustrates adjustable simulation guidance, with improvements over the baseline across the displayed weights.
paragraphs.zh: 表2显示，联合流匹配和轨迹增强在所有五个指标上均优于真实视频SFT。 在引入增强后，运动蒸馏实现了最低的FID和FVD，而将其与模拟条件结合则获得了最佳的PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS。 这反映了一种权衡：完整模型更优先保证预测保真度以及与参考视频的感知相似度，而非分布质量。 表3进一步显示，潜在运动蒸馏在四个指标上优于潜在值匹配，这表明时间差异是一种有效的迁移目标，能够减轻跨域外观差异的影响。 CFG为这种权衡提供了额外的控制：w = 0.6时获得了最佳的PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS，而w = 1时则实现了最低的FID和FVD。 图3（右侧）进一步展示了可调节的模拟引导效果，在所有显示的权重下均优于基线模型。

paragraphs.en: We compare two distillation objectives: latent value distillation, which matches the student’s predicted future latents to those of the frozen teacher, and latent motion distillation, which instead matches their differences between consecutive latent frames. Fig. 4 presents the corresponding distillation losses for the real and synthetic branches. On the real branch, the latent value loss remains approximately constant, whereas the latent motion loss decreases during training. On the synthetic branch, both objectives decrease in the later stages, with latent motion exhibiting an initial rise followed by a sustained decline. Since the two objectives supervise different quantities, their absolute loss magnitudes should not be interpreted as a direct comparison of model quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了两种蒸馏目标：潜在值蒸馏，即将学生模型预测的未来潜在状态与冻结教师模型的潜在状态进行匹配；以及潜在运动蒸馏，即匹配连续潜在帧之间的差异。 图 4 展示了真实分支和合成分支对应的蒸馏损失。 在真实分支中，潜在值损失基本保持不变，而潜在运动损失在训练过程中逐渐下降。 在合成分支中，两个目标在后期阶段均有所下降，其中潜在运动损失先上升，随后持续下降。 由于这两个目标监督的是不同的量，因此它们的绝对损失大小不应被直接解释为模型质量的对比。

paragraphs.en: Action-conditioned video prediction and downstream VLA learning share the same model architecture, with all pretrained parameters transferred to initialize the downstream model. The action expert changes from a conditioning branch to an action-prediction branch. Tab. 5 shows that this initialization improves average LIBERO success over Wan2.2 across all three policy-training settings. The largest gain occurs with action-only training, increasing average success from 82.6 % 82.6\% to 89.2 % 89.2\% , particularly through improvements on Goal and Long. Smaller gains persist with unconditional and joint video–action training, with consistent improvements on Long across settings. These results provide preliminary evidence that the pretrained world-model representations benefit downstream policy learning.
paragraphs.zh: 基于动作的视频预测与下游 VLA 学习共享相同的模型架构，所有预训练参数都会被转移以初始化下游模型。 动作专家从条件分支转变为动作预测分支。 表 5 显示，在所有三种策略训练设置中，这种初始化方法都比 Wan2.2 提升了 LIBERO 的平均成功率。 最大的提升出现在仅使用动作的训练中，平均成功率从 82.6 % 82.6\% 提高到了 89.2 % 89.2\%，尤其是在 Goal 和 Long 任务上的改进最为显著。 在无条件和联合视频–动作训练中也观察到了较小的提升，且所有设置下 Long 任务的性能均有稳定改善。 这些结果为预训练的世界模型表示有助于下游策略学习提供了初步证据。

paragraphs.en: We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework for action-conditioned robot video prediction. A simulation world model serves as a training-time teacher, transferring motion knowledge to a real-domain student through latent-motion distillation. Simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance complements these internalized priors with controllable guidance from predicted simulation latents, requiring only the final student model at inference. SimForcing achieves the best prediction fidelity and perceptual similarity among the compared methods without embodied pretraining, while downstream experiments provide preliminary evidence of its utility for policy learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SimForcing，这是一个以模拟为指导、用于基于动作的机器人视频预测的框架。 一个模拟世界模型在训练阶段充当教师，通过潜在运动蒸馏将运动知识迁移到真实域的学生模型中。 基于模拟条件且无需分类器的引导机制，利用预测出的模拟潜在变量提供可控的引导，从而补充这些内化的先验知识，并且在推理阶段仅需最终的学生模型。 SimForcing 在未进行具身预训练的情况下，在比较的方法中实现了最高的预测保真度和感知相似度，而下游实验则初步证明了其在策略学习中的实用性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate multi-block dropout conditioning on the Bridge validation set by varying the training-time condition retention probability p ∈ { 0 , 0.3 , 0.7 , 1.0 } p\in\{0,0.3,0.7,1.0\} and inference-time CFG weight w ∈ { 0 , 0.3 , 0.6 , 1.0 } w\in\{0,0.3,0.6,1.0\} . Here, p p is the probability of enabling simulation conditioning for each training sample, with the same gate shared across all video transformer blocks. paragraphs.en: Tables A2 and A3 show that increasing real-video generation from one to five or ten steps substantially improves prediction fidelity, while increasing from ten to twenty steps provides only small additional gains. paragraphs.en: We use a paired simulation–real subset of BridgeData V2 ( Walke et al., 2023 ) containing 1,952 robot manipulation trajectories. Each pair consists of temporally aligned simulated and real-world videos sharing the same action sequence, proprioceptive states, and language instruction. We retain trajectories containing at least 21 frames and randomly sample 30 temporal windows per eligible trajectory in each epoch. Each window contains 21 consecutive video frames and 20 aligned actions, with one action per video transition. Both actions and proprioceptive states are seven-dimensional. For evaluation, we select 100 paired samples from the validation set.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the transferability of our pretrained world model to robotic manipulation on the four LIBERO suites: Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long. As summarized in Table 5 , we compare Wan2.2-based initialization with our world-model initialization under three downstream training settings. The policy uses a video expert and an action expert coupled through attention. Its observations comprise an external-camera image and a wrist-camera image, concatenated spatially, together with the task instruction and the current proprioceptive state. The action expert predicts a sequence of end-effector motion and gripper commands. For the Wan2.2 baseline, the video expert is initialized from Wan2.2 and the action expert from the corresponding Wan2.2-derived ActionDiT initialization. For Our WM, both experts inherit the compatible weights of our pretrained world-model checkpoint. Thus, this comparison evaluates the transfer of the pretrained two-expert model, rather than a replacement of the visual backbone alone.

paragraphs.en: Here, both experts are optimized using video and action flow-matching objectives. Future video latents and action trajectories are independently corrupted with noise, while the initial observation remains clean and provides visual conditioning. The video expert predicts future visual dynamics without receiving action tokens or ground-truth actions. The action expert attends to its own action tokens and the video tokens of the initial observation, but cannot attend to future video tokens. The initial observation tokens are also prevented from attending to future frames, avoiding indirect access to future observations through the visual context. Consequently, video prediction supplies an auxiliary learning objective for the visual representation, while action prediction depends only on information available at decision time. The term unconditional refers specifically to the absence of action conditioning in the video branch; visual, language, and proprioceptive conditioning are retained. At inference, actions can be generated from the current observation without generating a future video.

sents.en: Future video latents and action trajectories are independently corrupted with noise, while the initial observation remains clean and provides visual conditioning.
sents.zh: 未来的视频潜在表示和动作轨迹会独立地加入噪声，而初始观察则保持干净，并提供视觉条件信息。

sents.en: The action expert attends to its own action tokens and the video tokens of the initial observation, but cannot attend to future video tokens.
sents.zh: 动作智能体会关注自身动作标记以及初始观察的视频标记，但无法关注未来的视频标记。

sents.en: The initial observation tokens are also prevented from attending to future frames, avoiding indirect access to future observations through the visual context.
sents.zh: 初始观察的标记也被禁止关注未来帧，从而避免通过视觉上下文间接获取未来观察信息。

sents.en: Consequently, video prediction supplies an auxiliary learning objective for the visual representation, while action prediction depends only on information available at decision time.
sents.zh: 因此，视频预测为视觉表示提供了一个辅助学习目标，而动作预测则仅依赖决策时刻可用的信息。

paragraphs.en: This setting retains the video and action flow-matching objectives and jointly optimizes both experts, but expands the action expert’s attention to the complete video token sequence. Action prediction can therefore use both the current observation and the evolving representations of future video frames. The coupling is directional: action tokens attend to video tokens, whereas video tokens do not attend to action tokens. During training, the future video tokens are noisy versions of demonstration latents. During inference, future video latents and actions are generated together from noise, with the initial observation fixed. Thus, the additional visual context available to the policy comes from predicted futures rather than ground-truth future observations.

paragraphs.en: Our world-model initialization improves the reported average success rate in all three settings: from 82.6 % 82.6\% to 89.2 % 89.2\% under action-only training, from 96.5 % 96.5\% to 97.5 % 97.5\% under unconditional training, and from 98.1 % 98.1\% to 98.4 % 98.4\% under video + action training. These correspond to gains of 6.6 6.6 , 1.0 1.0 , and 0.3 0.3 percentage points, respectively. The largest improvement occurs under action-only adaptation, including gains of 9.6 9.6 points on Goal and 15.2 15.2 points on Long. This result supports the usefulness of the transferred initialization even when the visual expert is frozen. The gains are smaller when both experts receive downstream video and action supervision. Video + action training with Our WM achieves the highest reported average success rate, 98.4 % 98.4\% , compared with 97.6 % 97.6\% for the FastWAM reference. The improvements are not uniform across suites: in the video + action setting, gains on Object and Long offset decreases on Spatial and Goal. Overall, the results support improved downstream transfer across the three training settings, without implying an improvement on every individual suite.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的世界模型初始化提升了所有三种设置中报告的平均成功率：在仅动作训练下，从 82.6% 提升至 89.2%；在无条件训练下，从 96.5% 提升至 97.5%；在视频+动作训练下，从 98.1% 提升至 98.4%。 这些提升分别对应 6.6、1.0 和 0.3 个百分点的增长。 最大的改进出现在仅动作适应中，包括在 Goal 上的 9.6 个点和 Long 上的 15.2 个点的增长。 这一结果支持了所转移的初始化的有效性，即使视觉专家被冻结时也是如此。 当两个专家都接受下游的视频和动作监督时，提升幅度会变小。 使用我们的世界模型进行的视频+动作训练实现了报告的最高平均成功率，为 98.4%，而 FastWAM 参考模型为 97.6%。 这些改进在不同套件中并不一致：在视频+动作设置中，Object 和 Long 上的提升抵消了 Spatial 和 Goal 上的下降。 总体而言，这些结果支持了三种训练设置下下游迁移能力的提升，但这并不意味着每个单独套件的性能都有改善。
